name: 左品牌區＋插圖＋右兩欄文字連結
desc: 左右各半的頁尾：左側由上往下是標誌、橫式插圖與一行小字，右側是兩欄沒有小標題的文字連結，右下角一排小圖示連結與左側小字同高。手機版改為上下排列，插圖移到連結下方。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的頁尾，放在頁面最下方，跟著頁面捲動。左右分成兩區，各約一半，內容對齊頁面內容寬度：左側是品牌區，標誌靠左上，下方隔一段空白可放一張橫式插圖，寬度約左區的六成多、明顯大於標誌，沒有時省略；右側從頁面中線開始，是兩欄並排的文字連結，沒有小標題，頂端和標誌頂端齊平；第一欄是文字較大、間距較寬的直向連結，第二欄是文字較小的直向連結，可再分成數小組、組與組之間多留一點空白。最下方一列是底部列：一行小字靠左，放在插圖正下方，另一側靠右可放一排小圖示連結，與那行小字同高，沒有時省略。
mobile: 左右兩區改為上下排列，全部靠左對齊：最上方是標誌；其下兩欄文字連結仍左右並排，左欄文字較大、右欄文字較小並分成數小組，全部展開；一排小圖示連結移到右欄連結下方並靠右，與左欄最後一個連結同高；接著隔一段空白放插圖，橫跨頁面內容寬度；最下方那行小字改為靠右。沒有動態效果。

en.name: Left brand block + illustration + right two text-link columns
en.desc: A footer split into two halves: the left stacks a logo, a landscape illustration and a line of small text; the right holds two columns of text links with no group headings, and a row of small icon links in the bottom-right corner sits level with the small text. On mobile the areas stack vertically and the illustration moves below the links.
en.prompt: Create a footer whose height is determined by its content, placed at the very end of the page and scrolling with it. It is split into two areas of roughly half each, aligned to the page content width: the left is the brand block, with a logo at its top-left and, after a gap below it, optionally a landscape illustration about two-thirds the width of the left area and clearly larger than the logo, omitted when there is no content. The right area starts at the page's center line and holds two side-by-side columns of text links with no group headings, their tops level with the top of the logo; the first column is a vertical list of larger text links with wider spacing, and the second column is a vertical list of smaller text links that may be divided into several small groups with a bit more space between groups. At the very bottom is the bottom bar: a line of small text aligned left, directly below the illustration, and optionally a row of small icon links aligned right on the other side, level with that line of small text, omitted when there is no content.
en.mobile: The two areas stack vertically, all aligned left: the logo comes first; below it the two text-link columns stay side by side, the left with larger text and the right with smaller text divided into several small groups, all expanded; the row of small icon links moves below the right column, aligned right and level with the last link of the left column; then, after a gap, the illustration spans the page content width; the line of small text at the very bottom becomes aligned right. There is no motion.
